tests.title: accepts only the bare token and refuses options, enable and unknown names with exact messages
negotiates native s16p for every input format and declares its capabilities, counts and reservation
refuses every input native would resample or remix, including a masked two-channel WAV layout
matches a naive whole-signal FIR across random frame splits, packed and planar input, and saturates like native
converts float and wide integer input through the negotiated s16p, and enforces allocation limits and cancellation
matches native WAV, raw and framecrc bytes for stereo 44100 Hz u8, s16, s32 and f32 sources and composed chains
matches native output time selection and frame limits after the cross-frame history
refuses mono, three-channel and 48000 Hz input before output where native converts implicitly, and refuses options native rejects

details: 160 exact byte comparisons: stereo 44100 Hz u8/s16le/s32le/f32le raw sources (-cpuflags 0) x 8 chains (earwax, asetnsamples=5,earwax, asetnsamples=31:p=0,earwax, asetnsamples=33,earwax,asetnsamples=7, earwax,apad=pad_len=9, volume=0.5,earwax, earwax,earwax, anull,earwax,volume=2) x 5 outputs (s16 WAV, s32 WAV, raw s16le, s16 framecrc, s32 framecrc)
12 framecrc comparisons with input -ss/-t and output -ss/-t/-to/-frames:a for earwax and asetnsamples=5,earwax
4 refusal cases (mono 44100, 3ch 44100, stereo 48000, mono 8000) asserting native exit 0 via auto-resample and EdgeFFmpeg failure before output
2 option refusals (earwax=1, earwax=enable=1) asserting native non-zero exit

unsupported: Inputs native converts implicitly (non-stereo, non-default two-channel WAV/W64 masks, rates other than 44100 Hz): refused with 'earwax requires stereo 44100 Hz input'
Any option, enable or runtime command: refused with 'Unsupported earwax option' (native has none)
FLAC input: refused before decoding (no flacInput)
Automatic sample-rate conversion around earwax (rateBoundary): refused
AU, AIFF and W64 outputs: same path, no native comparison

proposedContracts.name: matches a naive whole-signal FIR across random frame splits, packed and planar input, and saturates like native

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Native WAV to a pipe leaves header sizes unset, so the differential test writes native output to a seekable file.

The implementation computes output in place on the owned converted s16p frame, from the last sample backwards, instead of native's two scratch frames; reserve() is one frame plus 256 state bytes (one 64-entry s16 taps buffer per input channel).
Setup durations: submodule init 49 s, npm ci + reference:build 3 min 39 s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 1 min 8 s, baseline unit suite 1 min 35 s.
